rules: A URL or title establishes discoverability, not possession, accessibility, official status, or permission to copy.
Do not fetch paywalled, authenticated, private, restricted, or ambiguously licensed content.
Do not infer lecture order, assignment prompts, dependencies, editions, or solutions from aggregate metadata.
Keep examiner-only material out of every learner view.
Do not expose secrets, sealed references, hidden validation data, or another learner's files.
later_job_requirements: Use an explicitly authorized retriever and record the resolved URL, retrieval time, revision when applicable, content hash, license or access basis, and validation label.
Classify each retrieved artifact before adding it to the unit graph.
Preserve unavailable and failed-retrieval records rather than silently treating them as complete.
Only a worker-harness validator may promote retrieved material or learner work to a validated state.
